description: The developer's payout account (Stripe Connect), needed to sell products inside their apps. "status": none | pending | active | restricted, with chargesEnabled / payoutsEnabled. "onboarding_link": the neblla.com page where Stripe's own onboarding opens inside the developer's Neblla session, where they verify identity and add a bank account (a human must do it; never ask for bank details or documents in the chat: Stripe collects them there, Neblla never sees them); the first time it opens the account. A developer who already uses Stripe signs in with it there. Paid products waiting for the account publish by themselves once it is active. "dashboard_link": the developer's own Stripe Dashboard (payments, payouts, refunds, disputes, taxes); they sign in with their Stripe login. The account is the developer's: Stripe's fees, refunds, disputes and any negative balance are on it, not on Neblla. "disconnect" stops Neblla selling on their behalf and HIDES every paid product from users; the Stripe account itself is kept, so reconnecting later returns to the same one. It needs confirm: true, and only when the developer asked for it in as many words. Products stay hidden from users until the status is active. Commission: Neblla takes 1 % of each sale, before tax; Stripe's own fee is separate and paid by the developer's account (the charge is made there: the developer is the seller).
name: neblla_payments_account
